title: 第3章 天脉者第4章 混沌空间第二层奖励吸功大法
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
lines: 一个时辰后。
叶凡走出大殿，扫了一眼死狗一样的秦风，淡淡下令：“把他挂在公爵府门外，别让他死了！”
王大年让人将秦风拉走！
“住手！”
李幽若从大殿里冲出来，手持一把匕首，抵住叶凡的脖子，她感觉身体被撕裂一样，站都站不稳。
“王爷！”
王大年等人冲过来！
“都给我站住！”
李幽若发狠，仿佛又成了那至高无上的大夏长公主：“谁敢再上前一步，我立刻杀了叶凡！”
公爵府一众甲士全都站在原地，不敢乱动。
“叶凡，快下令放了秦风，再去宫里找御医为秦风续上断肢，否则我杀了你！”
“你敢吗？”
叶凡丝毫没把李幽若的威胁放在眼里。
“你以为我不敢？”李幽若愤怒。
叶凡好笑的摇头，再一次下令：“王大年，给我剁了秦风一条腿喂狗，用最好的止血药，别让他死了！”
“王爷……”王大年惊了。
公主殿下的刀，都架到您脖子上了！
您怎么还敢说这种话啊！
叶凡只有两个字：“执行！”
王大年不敢怠慢，让人控制住秦风，手起刀落，秦风一条腿当场被砍下来，早就准备好的止血药撒上去。
一名甲士牵来一条黑狗，将秦风的大腿和断肢丢过去。
“啊！我的宝贝……我的宝贝啊！”
秦风发疯一样的大叫。
“风哥！”
李幽若的心几乎崩溃，白月光的大腿和男人象征，都被狗吞掉。
叶凡的脸上挂着笑容：“你不是要杀我吗？”
“放了秦风，不许再伤害他一根毛发！否则，我立刻死给你看！”
李幽若匕首一转，抵住自己的脖子。
叶凡道：“再给我砍掉秦风一条大腿喂狗！”
王大年手起刀落，秦风最后一条腿和身体分离。
秦风痛的昏死过去。
“叶凡！你真不怕我自尽吗？”
叶凡微笑：“明天一早，我上奏皇帝。”
“新婚之日，公主突发怪病暴毙！我八姐手握八十万大军，你猜皇帝信不信我？”
李幽若的瞳孔收缩，浑身都在发抖，俏脸更是煞白！
content_en:
An hour later.
Ye Fan walked out of the hall, glanced at Qin Feng who was like a dead dog, and ordered lightly: "Hang him outside the door of the Duke's Mansion, don't let him die!"
"Yes!"
Wang Danian asked someone to take Qin Feng away!
"Stop!"
Li Youruo rushed out of the hall, holding a dagger and holding it against Ye Fan's neck. She felt like her body was being torn apart and she couldn't stand still.
"Your Majesty!"
Wang Danian and others rushed over!
"Everyone, stop!"
Li Youruo became fierce, as if he had become the supreme eldest princess of Daxia again: "Whoever dares to take another step forward, I will kill Ye Fan immediately!"
All the soldiers in the Duke's Mansion stood still and did not dare to move.
"Ye Fan, quickly order Qin Feng to be released, and then go to the palace to find an imperial doctor to reattach Qin Feng's severed limb, otherwise I will kill you!"
"Do you dare?"
Ye Fan didn't take Li Youruo's threat seriously at all.
"You think I don't dare?" Li Youruo was angry.
Ye Fan shook his head funny and ordered again: "Wang Danian, chop off one of Qin Feng's legs and feed it to the dog. Use the best hemostatic medicine. Don't let him die!"
"Your Majesty..." Wang Danian was shocked.
Her Royal Highness the Princess’s knife is on your neck!
How dare you say such things!
Ye Fan only had two words: "Execute!"
"Yes!"
Wang Danian did not dare to neglect, and asked someone to control Qin Feng, and raised the knife. Qin Feng's leg was cut off on the spot, and the hemostatic medicine that had been prepared long ago was sprinkled on it.
A soldier brought a black dog and threw Qin Feng's thigh and severed limb.
"Ah! My baby...my baby!"
Qin Feng yelled like crazy.
"Brother Feng!"
Li Youruo's heart almost collapsed. Bai Yueguang's thigh and symbol of man were both eaten by the dog.
Mark had a smile on his face: "Aren't you going to kill me?"
"You..."
"Let Qin Feng go, and don't hurt any more of his hair! Otherwise, I will die for you immediately!"
Li Youruo turned the dagger and put it against his neck.
Ye Fan said: "Cut off one of Qin Feng's thighs and feed it to the dog!"
Wang Danian raised his knife and dropped it, and Qin Feng's last leg was separated from his body.
"Ah——!"
Qin Feng fainted from the pain.
"Ye Fan! Are you really not afraid that I will commit suicide?"
"Please!"
Ye Fan smiled: "Tomorrow morning, I will report to the emperor."
"On her wedding day, the princess suddenly died of a strange illness! My eighth sister has an army of 800,000 people. Do you think the emperor believes me?"
Li Youruo's pupils shrank, his whole body was trembling, and his pretty face turned pale!
